en.headline: Dali Station to Dali Old Town: Choose the Right Gate and Drop-off
en.description: Match your hotel to South, Erhai, Cangshan or North Gate, save a Chinese destination card and avoid dragging luggage across Dali Old Town.
en.heroAlt: The South Gate building of Dali Old Town in Yunnan, photographed in January 2023.
